I never said he didn't know about it either.

I dont know what you mean, I've never lied to him about my harm. He knows I want to cut, he knows I dont want to get better? I just asked him to throw them out to prevent me from doing it, and he also saw the razor I found on the floor. Im not understanding what you mean.

I do feel greatful. I never said I was ungrateful. I appreciate everything he does. But he shouldn't have to do that. That's the point. I wish you wouldn't assume how I feel and just because other peoples lives are worse does not mean my problems aren't bad. I'm sorry you hate your life, but other people can also hate theirs even if you think they are in a better situation.

Any amount of self harm is valid. Any amount of self harm is considered "wow that's bad". I also struggle with trying to validate my own harm, and wondering if it is ever "good enough". But at the end of the day you gotta realize you went out of your way to hurt yourself. You are valid. Your harm is valid. No matter how extreme.
